title: Plank the Trail
prompt:
**Description:** A trail has n checkpoints with heights h_1..h_n. Between checkpoint i-1 and i the climbers face an upward step of max(0, h_i - h_{i-1}). You may install wooden planks: one plank reduces the upward step along one gap by 1 (any number per gap). With at most k planks, minimize the **largest remaining upward step**. Print that step.

**Input:** Line 1: n k (2 <= n <= 10^5, 0 <= k <= 10^14). Line 2: n heights (0 <= h_i <= 10^9).
**Output:** One integer.

**Example:** `4 2` / `1 5 5 9` -> up-steps 4, 0, 4; two planks on one gap leave 2 -> `2`.
